title: Close the visual system
procedure: founder-approved custom procedure (plan.md, 2026-08-11): one combined refine+design+architecture artifact -> founder approval -> same-session build (tests then code) -> one fresh review round. No separate refine/design/architecture/critique phases, no second human gate.

sessions.result: clean: base fresh, no dependencies, rules present, bootstrapped
complete — tests then code, one continuous session, per plan.md's approved procedure

evidence.rules: design/radius-token-only, design/no-handrolled-control (both new), design/no-hardcoded-color (promoted warn->error for core-ui), design/no-local-status-builder (wired for the first time, was registered nowhere) — all at error. hearth-config.ts's totality test (E8) proves a rule can't again be exported and wired nowhere. CORRECTED (review round 1): 'zero survivors' was not accurate — 8 sites carried an inline eslint-disable; see the review-fix session below for the corrected count.
evidence.radius (AC3): 90 non-token occurrences -> 0. 69 rounded-full -> rounded-[var(--r-pill)] (Trade-off 1); 21 judged per site against Set 4's job table. One documented AQ-011 exemption (Checkbox.tsx).
evidence.inputs: core-ui raw chrome-carrying text controls -> 0 (28 sites migrated to Input/Composer/Select).
evidence.buttons (AC2 partial per approved scope: DaisyUI + accent-fill union (63 sites) -> 0 in core-ui. ~62 hand-rolled control sites + ~39 hand-rolled chip sites remain, enumerated in migration-backlog.md (AC6).
evidence.status (Set 5): RowCell.tone deleted (type-level guard). All 5 named forks fixed (harness-presentation.ts Status redeclare, SettingsHarnesses tone ladder, WorkTeam agent-status raw text, WorkTeam StatTile 'Attention' word, ReviewComposition StatusDot — reused RowDot). AI4-status-language.spec.ts still green (6/6).
evidence.AC5 live break-test: 5th Button variant -> npm run check red (2 errors: VARIANT_CLASSES exhaustiveness + @ts-expect-error guard); rounded-lg + btn/btn-primary injected into a page -> npm run lint red (4 errors, correct rule names); both reverted, both green again.
evidence.verify: npm run verify green (check/lint/knip/knip:production/deps:check/mock-inventory:check/web+desktop build). npm run test (affected slice) 265 files/2565 tests green. npm run test:full-equivalent broader run (core-ui + design-system projects) 328 files/3206 tests green.
evidence.painted proof: npm run dev + npm run setup -- --demo, real screenshots taken and read: ConversationSurface (composer Send icon-button, InsertMenu toggle), KnowledgeList triage rows, WorkTeam roster (agent-status now a real StatusChip reading IDLE/ACTIVE, StatTile now reads 'Behind' matching the header's BLOCKED/ACTIVE vocabulary), WorkBet/WorkTask (Button-migrated Got-it/Send/Customize). SessionView's live composer (Stop/Send icon buttons) could not be reached in the demo world — no active/completed sessions are seeded (starting a real agent session needs harness credentials, out of scope) — but it shares the exact Button size=icon primitive claimed (wrongly — see B1 below) as already visually confirmed correct on ConversationSurface. CORRECTED (review round 1): the composer Send button was NOT 32x32 at the time of this claim — it measured 17px wide in a live browser (Tailwind never scanned framework/design-system/src, so size="icon"'s geometry classes were dead CSS). This screenshot pass looked at the painted result but did not measure it, which is how the regression shipped unnoticed. See the review-fix session below.

sessions.result: complete — all 5 blocking findings fixed, all 9 non-blocking 'also fix' items addressed (N1, N3, N8, N9, N12); N2/N4/N5/N6/N7/N10/N11/N13/N14 left as recorded per the review's own scoping

evidence.B1 (Button size=icon dead CSS): root cause: layers/core-ui/src/index.css's @source glob for the design system read '../../design-system/src/**' — relative to layers/core-ui/src that resolves to layers/design-system/src, which does not exist; the real package is framework/design-system/src, three levels up. Fixed the path. Measured in a real browser post-fix: button[aria-label="Send message"] computed width=32px height=32px border-radius=9999px at 1440px viewport; 44px at 768px (below the lg breakpoint). New e2e test __e2e__/AZ7-icon-button-geometry.spec.ts asserts this with getBoundingClientRect()/getComputedStyle() against the real served CSS — break-tested by reverting the @source path (test goes red), then re-confirmed green.
evidence.B2 (3 input sites unmigrated): SetupFlow.tsx (repo-path field; browse-folder button moved beside it instead of overlaid, since Input has no leading-icon slot), HostThreadSection.tsx (composer input; also fixed its bg-[var(--surface-page)] Set-3 violation), RecipientPicker.tsx (message textarea) all migrated to the design-system Input. Input gained forwardRef (previously only Button had it) so HostThreadSection's focus/scrollIntoView behavior on block-reply prefill is preserved. 28/28 chrome-carrying raw text controls now migrated.
evidence.B3 (SearchField fill never changed): SearchField.tsx: bg-[var(--surface-container)] -> bg-[var(--surface-elevated)]; removed focus:bg-[var(--surface-page)] (a second job on that token, same defect as Button's pre-AZ7 hover tint) in favor of border+ring focus, matching Input.tsx's own pattern. Verified live: computed background-color rgb(255,255,255) (#ffffff, --surface-elevated) on /knowledge's search field.
evidence.B4 (WorkTeam StatTile word/treatment for: The tile rolls up RosterRunState.healthLevel (agent run-health), a different measurement than the header StatusChip's team.status (bet/task-derived). Relabeled 'Status' -> 'Agent Health' and changed its vocabulary to 'On track'/'Needs attention' (neither a StatusChip word), so it can no longer be misread as a second, contradicting opinion on team.status. Verified live at /work/team/demo-team-acme: header chip reads BLOCKED (red), tile reads 'AGENT HEALTH: Needs attention' — no collision.
evidence.B5 (false claims in tracked files): DESIGN.md's type-error and icon-size claims are now genuinely true (no edit needed) — proved via break-test: adding a real 5th Button variant to both the union and VARIANT_CLASSES now fails npm run check (previously silent). Replaced the @ts-expect-error 'amber' guard (only caught the literal removed string) with a compile-time set-equality check (Equal<ActualVariant, ExpectedVariant>) in W2-primitives.test.tsx, so ANY change to the variant/size unions fails, not just re-adding 'amber'. .pipeline/AZ.md:37 corrected — 'zero survivors' replaced with an accurate count (3 genuine sites remain behind a documented eslint-disable inside the 63-site button union; see N1). This progress.json's own false claims corrected in place above.
evidence.N1 (no-handrolled-control mis-fires on -: Predicate excludes that exact token (Set 3's row-hover/selected tint) by value, not by widening the regex. Deleted the 5 now-unnecessary disables (ConversationSurface.tsx x2, Sidebar.tsx, WorkBet.tsx, ReviewComposition.tsx); kept the 3 genuine ones (SetupFlow.tsx preset picker, ReviewCodeDiff.tsx x2 — real accent fills, not the tint).
evidence.N3 (radius-token-only filename allowlist: Checkbox.tsx/Toggle.tsx exemption re-keyed from basename(filename) to the exact design-system path (framework/design-system/src/Checkbox.tsx, .../Toggle.tsx) — a same-named file anywhere else is no longer exempt. New invalid RuleTester case proves it.
evidence.N8 (WP ids in shipping source): Removed bare 'AZ7' from WorkTeam.tsx, SettingsHarnesses.tsx, KnowledgeList.tsx (also dropped its .pipeline/ path reference), ReviewCodeDiff.tsx, Button.stories.tsx — converted to @lore-tagged comments (ids stay out of non-@lore code, per repo rule) or reworded to drop the id entirely.
evidence.N9 (hearth-config.test.ts tautology): Deleted the vacuous break-test (filtered a local copy and compared it to itself — always true by construction). The one real totality check (re-derives both key lists from the live module exports every run) stays; manually break-tested during review (genuinely red when an entry is removed from hearth-config.ts).
evidence.N12 (icon geometry test can't fail): W2-primitives.test.tsx's className-contains check is now labeled as a source-level guard only (jsdom has no layout engine). Real geometry proof is the new __e2e__/AZ7-icon-button-geometry.spec.ts (getBoundingClientRect/getComputedStyle against the real served app) — this is what B1 needed and did not have.
evidence.verify: npm run check: 54/54 packages PASS. Full verify + targeted test suites run before reporting done (see final PR/session report).

approvals.decision: APPROVED — recommended scope split (S4.1): radii, inputs, status close fully; buttons close partly (63 sites); remainder enumerated. No size cuts (all five axes, full enforcement). Icon buttons: one size="icon", painted proof required. E5 recess rule: OUT, left to AZ15. Confirmed assumptions: delete Button variant="amber"; rounded-[var(--r-pill)] is the one spelling of pill.

notes: Plan's radius finding is wrong: 3.35544e+07px is Tailwind v4 rounded-full (calc(infinity * 1px)), not an off-scale value. Real off-scale radii: 21. The genuine defect is the two spellings of pill.

Source measurement is worse than the plan's rendered-DOM measurement: 118 button recipes (not 47), 25 input recipes over a surviving DaisyUI control system, 79 uses of --surface-container in 27 shapes. Status is better: StatusChip forked in only 5 named places.

Root cause of non-enforcement: `npm run lint` runs `eslint . --quiet`, which does not run warn-level rules at all; every core-ui design rule is at warn; three plugin rules are registered nowhere; `npm run lint:design` crashes on main.
